title: 低功耗策略：睡眠→待机
description: The following example explains how to change the power policy from SLEEP0 to STANDBY0 during runtime. There are two timers in use: TIMG0 and TIMG1. TIMG1 is sourced from the SYSOSC, and can run in SLEEP but not STANDBY. TIMG0 is sourced from the low-frequency LFCLK, and therefore can run in all stat（SDK 例程：sysctl_power_policy_sleep_to_standby）
